author_claim: TEM-1 backbone is unusually ordered on the ps-ns scale (mean S2 0.90), including termini and the Omega-loop; active-site residues around Ser70 have S2 above 0.94. Per-residue S2, S2f, tau_e and model in SI Tables S7-S10.
